name: Warchief's Orders
summary: Warchief’s Orders are a dispatch carried by a Horde force bound for the Blasted Lands. Their recovery reveals the cost of an ambush in Stagalbog.

sections.title: The Lost Dispatch
sections.body: A wounded Horde survivor names the orders as a dispatch from the commander. His force was traveling toward the Blasted Lands when murlocs ambushed them in the Swamp of Sorrows. The murloc called Swamp Talker seized the orders and struck him down. The dispatch now lies in Stagalbog Cave, while the survivor waits for help.

sections.title: A Costly Mistake
sections.body: The Fallen Hero of the Horde reads the dispatch and learns that nineteen of his men suffered because he acted rashly. He cannot reach them himself and asks you to help those still in agony. The orders have brought him the truth, but the wounded remain in need.

faq.answer: They are a dispatch given to a Horde force traveling toward the Blasted Lands.
Swamp Talker, a murloc in Stagalbog Cave, seized the orders during an ambush.
The orders lie in Stagalbog Cave in the Swamp of Sorrows.
The Fallen Hero of the Horde awaits the orders.

faq.q: What happened to the Horde force?
faq.answer: Murlocs ambushed the force on its way to the Blasted Lands. The Fallen Hero says nineteen men suffered because he acted rashly.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you see what a lost dispatch costs its soldiers: the Fallen Hero learns that nineteen of his men suffered, and asks you to help them.
